Your Europe (EU): Bank accounts in the EU
Central Bank of Ireland: What is IBAN discrimination?

whatItIs: Optional. A euro account from another SEPA country works in Italy: companies and employers must accept a euro IBAN from any SEPA country.
The transport pass can be paid by card, so it does not need an Italian account.

bring.text: Your unibz certificate of enrolment or a self-declaration
Your residence permit or the post office receipt for your application, if you are a non-EU citizen

afterArrival: Compare banks' offers and open the account at a branch. Some online-only accounts are open only to Italian residents.
Ask the bank before you go whether it needs anything else; this guide does not recommend a bank.
commonMistakes: Opening an account you do not need. Check first whether your home account works for rent and bills.
Going before you have the tax code. Banks ask for it.
whatComesNext: Use the Italian IBAN for rent or other payments, if you need it.
